Red is muscle, cream is the space inside a chamber. Click on the flat cut face. The dot lands exactly on the cutting plane, so there is nothing to judge about depth.
Axis 1/2/3 choose which way the knife points; the model's orientation is unverified, so they are named by axis rather than by anatomy. Face me cuts square-on to wherever you have rotated. Reverse cuts from the other side. Nothing is pre-labelled — the cream is the undivided cavity, not any guess about where the chambers divide.
